info.name: Smart Durian Farm - QR Traceability Local Test
info.description: Manual requests only; no scripts or environments. Start API/web as QR_TRACEABILITY_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Create data through existing module collections and replace PASTE_* by hand. For A→B, wait 15 minutes for each Cultivation version to lock. All requests deliberately No Auth; last request verifies private API still requires JWT. Backend RAM resets on restart.
